main_text.head: COSTERVS.
main_text.p: CATHOLICI contrà, vt filij sponsæ, in Christi sponsi gloriam, omnes conatus & studia conserunt: vnde non ipsius personam modò, sed ea quoque omnia, quæ ipsum quoquo modo attingunt, ad maiorem sponsi gloriam, piè venerantur; Matrem, ministros, imagines, sacramenta, passionem, merita, vicarios, &c. Hinc tot sacræ ceremoniæ, tot dies festi, tot templa, tot altaria, tot monasteria, tot vota, tot peregrinationes, tot ieiunia & bona opera, tanta maiorum obseruantia, tam humilis obedientia.
main_text.head: GOMARVS.
main_text.p: INSIGNE profecto elogium, in Christi gloriam omnes suos conatus conferre ! verùm si Christi personam, officia, beneficia, cultum, sponsam, varijs modis violare, gloriam illius illustrare est, fatebor equidem libens meritoque, vobis huius studij laudem, cum primis

page.notes: Catchword "primis" appears at the foot of the page; it is recorded in the text as the last word. Passage on the page is in roman with italic inserts as printed.
